messages.author: 299a5089d6c6c523
messages.subject: Re: RODBC Firebird connection
parts:
I see a few problems:

1) You appear to be specifying your server's address as "10.42.3.4" which is in the private address space and would not be accessible from shinyapps.io servers. You need to specify a public IP address or host name.
2) It isn't clear to me that FreeTDS supports Firebird, just MS SQL Server and Sybase

There is an actual Firebird ODBC driver, but it is not available in the Ubuntu repositories, and is not currently installed in shinyapps.io.

I'll speak with the team and see if it makes sense to add, but at this moment I would say that it is not supported.
